reasons.action: The brief explicitly asks for a spoken performance ('say the line on the recording again'), an audio/action instruction with no visual reference to inherit from.
reasons.medium: The medium_decision is no_reference with no requested style, so rendering-medium permission is host-owned; no reference supplies a medium to retain.
reasons.wardrobe: No visual reference is attached, so clothing is entirely determined by the request rather than any observed source.
reasons.lighting: No visual reference is attached and no illuminating instruction is given, so lighting is left to the request.
reasons.framing: No visual reference is attached; the 16:9 canvas is a ratio, not a camera composition, so framing is request-governed.
reasons.palette: No visual reference is attached, so scene color is determined by the request.
